anchor: Which evil fiend returns to life after dying, and uses a toxin-laced bite plus a life-draining ray?
Which evil fiend gets three attacks a turn and can freeze a person in place twice a day, then teleport short distances?
What quick touch magic can end one of several afflictions on an ally: blindness, deafness, frozen limbs, or toxin effects?
My friend can't see or hear after a brutal fight, and I can touch them using a quick extra move on my turn. What helps?
When something I can see hurts me from up to 60 feet away, can I answer with a fiery burst as an instant response?
Is there an instant spell that lets me punish a foe who hurt me from 60 feet with 2d10 burning harm, halved if it dodges?
What touch magic brings back a companion who died a minute ago, but uses up a gem worth 300 gold?
My friend died a few moments ago. Can I bring them back to 1 HP by touch, and does it regrow lost limbs?
Which magic band conjures a ghostly horned sheep's head that shoves foes 5 feet back and deals 2d10 pure magical harm?
Which magic band with three charges recharges at dawn and can be spent to smash a plain object I'm not carrying?
Which heavenly creature can't have its thoughts read by any means, bites to inflict toxins, and sees through illusions and disguises?
Which kindly flying celestial is immune to mind-based and holy-light harm and can squeeze a small foe to hold it?
Which uncommon magic band lets its wearer cast a spell that lets them step across lakes, targeting only themselves?
Which high-level spell makes a giant liquid barrier that rolls forward 50 feet a turn and bashes creatures inside?
Which eighth-level magic traps foes in a rushing flood, where they can't move unless they beat my spell's save DC on a brawn test?
What quick reaction slows up to five tumbling allies so they take no harm when they hit the ground?
What magic needs a bit of bird fluff as its component and slows descents to 60 feet per round?
Which tiny fey creature can vanish from sight and fire an arrow that beguiles its target until its next turn?
Which pint-sized fey can sense a nearby creature's emotions and moral leanings with a roll against personality, unless it's a fiend or undead?
Which humanoid can drop to 1 HP instead of dying once per long rest, and has 120 feet of sight in the dark?
Which humanoid species can sprint as a quick extra move and get temporary hit points equal to its training bonus?
What set of playing cards can summon a warrior ally who serves me until death, or make a pile of jewelry appear?
Which playing-card treasure can grant me a reality-bending spell one to three times, but might permanently shrink my mental stats?
Which earth creature can tunnel through solid rock without disturbing it and sniff out gold and gems nearby?
Is there a stone-dwelling monster that makes four strikes a turn, one bite and three claw swipes, and burrows through rock?
Which magic clothing flashes shifting light that can stun bystanders who fail a willpower check, and makes attackers miss more?
When I'm surrounded in a fight, can my magic garment throw out a bright glow to stun foes and refill its three uses at sunrise?
Which magic pouch pulls a random wild beast from nowhere, like a striped predatory cat or a massive woodland bear?
Which magic container, when I roll a d8, could conjure a dog-like hunter, a monkey, or a bird with a chopping beak?
Which touch hex makes a foe unable to judge situations well, weakens its rolls, or adds grim extra damage when I strike?
What touch magic forces a creature to pass a willpower roll each turn or spend its turn just defending itself?
Which spell sends a tiny creature to carry up to twenty-five words to someone I describe, covering roughly 25 miles a day?
Can I send a short note to a far-off person with a tiny critter, but it has to succeed on a charm-resistance roll?
What ward lets me touch a willing ally so that undead, fiends and fey have disadvantage attacking them and can't charm or scare them?
My ally needs a ten-minute ward against monsters from other planes, and I'm willing to spend blessed water; which spell is it?
What starting gear options exist for a nature-magic class: leather armor with a sickle and herb kit, or just 50 gold?
Which large blazing creature burns everything within ten feet at the end of its turn and takes cold harm when it moves through water?
Which large creature of living blaze ignores toxins and flames, lights up a 30-foot radius, and moves 50 feet a turn?
What magic fills a stairwell with sticky strands that regrow within ten minutes, and can also make a corridor's wind blow?
To secure a building, what spell can place glowing lights that repeat a routine in four corridors and an enchanted mouth in two spots?
What musical instrument makes creatures within 30 feet panic for a minute unless they pass a willpower check?
After a creature shrugs off a musical magic that scares it, how long is it protected from that same tune?
Which seafaring rogue carries a sword and a flintlock, and can add 3 to its armor against a melee hit as a reaction?
If a sea-going commander charms a visible foe within 30 feet that fails a willpower roll, how long does the enchantment last?
If I break a magic rod over my knee, what happens: a fifty percent chance to escape to another plane, else sixteen times its remaining charges in magical harm?
When an enchanted pole is deliberately smashed for a 30-foot blast, what Dexterity test do bystanders face and what harm per charge if they fail?
What 10-foot shell of nullification stops every spell and enchanted item inside it, and blocks teleporting in or out?
Can a dispelling effect end a 10-foot zone that blocks all spellcasting, and do enchantments already running inside it keep counting down?
Which spell creates a 60-foot-long rush of air lasting up to a minute that shoves creatures 15 feet and snuffs out candles?
Which spell can clear gas or vapor from a room and let me redirect the breeze with a quick extra move on later turns?
Which sixth-level spell forms a frozen barrier of up to ten 10-foot panels that is weak against flames and hurts creatures it cuts through with 10d6 bitter-chill harm?
What spell lets me create a bitter-cold dome 10 feet in radius that, once smashed, leaves a sheet of chill air behind?
Which furred footwear lets its wearer shrug off cold harm in temperatures down to zero Fahrenheit and cross icy or snowy ground without slowing?
Can I wear something that negates the slowing effect of frosty terrain and lets me handle cold without extra gear?
Which huge swimmer with five heads grows two new ones per turn for each lost head, unless it took burning harm since its last turn?
Which giant creature can hold its breath for an hour and can't be blinded, charmed, deafened, scared, stunned, or knocked out?
Which large beast grabs a Large or smaller victim with pincers and stings with a toxin that adds 2d10 harm?
Which beast senses nearby things without sight out to 60 feet, and has around 52 hit points and 40 feet of speed?
Which undead bloodsucker can close half its speed in distance and make one death-touched attack as one ability?
Which seductive fiend can shapeshift after a long rest into a male counterpart and lowers a charmed victim's maximum hit points?
Which evil fiend can charm a victim with a dominating spell, then drain its life total with a kiss, and fly 60 feet?
Which fiend's ranged attack reaches 150 feet, deals 5d6 burning harm, and sets a flammable loose object on fire?
Which large demon can blink 120 feet, shrugs off frost, flames and electric bolts, and reforms in its home plane after dying elsewhere?
Which heavy fiend has advantage against spells and unleashes a 15-foot shriek that scares and mentally hurts nearby foes unless they pass a willpower roll?
What condition gives me disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks, like being sickened by a toxin?
After a venom-tipped bite, my swings and skill checks all suffer a penalty. What is my status?
At paladin level two, instead of a combat feat, can I pick up two divine cantrips from the cleric list, and what ability do they use?
Can I swap one of my two starting divine magic tricks later when I gain a new class level, or are they locked in forever?
Which sack-shaped treasure is really a hungry extradimensional mouth that has a fifty percent chance to pull in anyone reaching inside?
If I get dragged inside a magic sack's otherworldly stomach, what check gets me out, and what is its difficulty?
Which 34-card set creates lifelike fake creatures when a random card is tossed to the floor within 30 feet?
How can a bystander tell a conjured creature is just an image, and how hard is the close-look test?
Right after my weapon hits, can I make grasping plants wrap around the foe, letting it resist with a brawn roll?
A creature tangled by plant tendrils takes what harm at the start of each turn, and how can it break free?
Which random magic-stick effect is a minute of heavy rain covering a 60-foot-radius column that dims vision?
